newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada judge says can't rule in stowaways case.
newsitem.headline: Canada judge says can't rule in stowaways case.

text.p: A Canadian judge said on Thursday that he had no jurisdiction to order six Taiwanese sailors accused of killing three Romanian stowaways at sea extradited to Romania to face murder charges.

But Nova Scotia Supreme Court Judge Michael MacDonald said there was enough evidence presented at a 41-day hearing to warrant sending the men, all officers of the merchant ship Maersk Dubai, to trial on manslaughter charges for casting the stowaways adrift, which resulted in their presumed deaths.
